nodes.name: Institutional Equity Trader
nodes.description: Executes equity block and algorithmic orders through TraderX Workstation.

nodes.name: TraderX Blotter Web UI
nodes.description: Browser order blotter for institutional equity trading desks.

nodes.name: Zero-Trust Edge API Gateway
nodes.description: Envoy-based ingress gateway terminating TLS 1.3 and enforcing OIDC bearer tokens.

nodes.name: Enterprise OIDC Identity Provider
nodes.description: Issues short-lived FAPI-compliant OAuth 2.1 / OIDC tokens for trading desks.

nodes.name: Kafka Order Event Backbone
nodes.description: Partitioned low-latency event log carrying order commands, risk approvals, and execution fills.

nodes.name: Stateless Order Router
nodes.description: Validates FIX/REST order payloads, assigns clOrdId, and orchestrates routing.

nodes.name: Pre-Trade Risk Engine
nodes.description: Evaluates SEC 15c3-5 market-access credit thresholds, fat-finger collars, and restricted lists.

nodes.name: In-Memory Intraday Position Cache
nodes.description: Low-latency Redis Enterprise cluster tracking desk gross/net exposure in real time.

nodes.name: FIX 4.4 Venue Execution Gateway
nodes.description: Manages persistent QuickFIX sessions, drop-copy listeners, and child-order routing to exchanges.

nodes.name: External Equity Exchange Venue
nodes.description: Regulated matching engine accepting institutional FIX order flow and returning ExecutionReports.

nodes.name: Consolidated NBBO Market Data Ticker
nodes.description: Normalizes SIP/direct-feed NBBO quotes for fat-finger collar and mark-to-market valuation.

nodes.name: Canonical Trade Ledger Service
nodes.description: Idempotent double-entry trade booking service consuming execution fills.

nodes.name: Cloud-Native PostgreSQL Trade Store
nodes.description: High-availability PostgreSQL cluster storing canonical trade bookings and allocations.

nodes.name: DTCC Clearing & Settlement Adapter
nodes.description: Generates T+1 institutional trade affirmations and clearing instructions.

nodes.name: Immutable Audit Archiver
nodes.description: Hashes order/fill event envelopes into Merkle batches and seals them into WORM storage.

nodes.name: SEC 17a-4 WORM Object-Lock Vault
nodes.description: Compliance-mode S3 Object Lock bucket preventing deletion or mutation for 7 years.

nodes.name: Surveillance & Compliance Officer
nodes.description: Inspects trade reconstruction evidence and cryptographic WORM proofs during supervisory reviews.

relationships.description: Trader submits and monitors orders via web blotter.
Web blotter sends authenticated order requests over HTTPS.
Web blotter performs OAuth 2.1 PKCE login handshake.
Gateway validates JWT signatures via OIDC JWKS endpoint.
Gateway dispatches validated client orders to stateless router over mTLS.
Order router publishes normalized OrderSubmitted events.
Risk engine reads intraday net exposure counters over TLS.
Order router invokes synchronous pre-trade limit check over mTLS.
FIX gateway consumes risk-approved orders from Kafka.
FIX gateway transmits NewOrderSingle messages over leased TLS session.
Ticker streams live NBBO reference prices into Redis cache.
Ticker pushes volatility circuit-breaker halts to pre-trade risk.
FIX gateway publishes ExecutionReport fills and busts back to Kafka.
Trade ledger consumes execution fills and lifecycle transitions from Kafka.
Trade ledger writes ACID trade records over JDBC.
Clearing adapter consumes booked trade events from Kafka.
Clearing adapter reconciles allocation state against PostgreSQL.
Archiver streams all order, risk, and fill topics from Kafka.
Archiver writes SHA-256 chained Parquet batches into WORM vault.
Compliance officer verifies immutable order-trail proofs.

mtls-everywhere.description: Requires SPIFFE/SPIRE mTLS certificates across internal service-to-service trading hops.

config.name: East-West Mutual TLS Enforcement
config.description: Requires SPIFFE/SPIRE mTLS certificates across internal service-to-service trading hops.

sec-17a4-worm.description: Enforces compliance-mode Object Lock with 7-year retention and cryptographic hash verification on trade audit records.

config.name: SEC Rule 17a-4 Immutable Recordkeeping
config.description: Enforces compliance-mode Object Lock with 7-year retention and cryptographic hash verification on trade audit records.

flows.name: Risk-Gated Client Order Submission Flow
flows.description: Client order ingress gated by synchronous SEC 15c3-5 pre-trade risk verification prior to Kafka publication.

transitions.description: Blotter posts HTTPS order to edge gateway.
Gateway routes order to stateless order router.
Order router executes synchronous SEC 15c3-5 risk check.
Risk engine verifies intraday exposure in Redis cache.
Approved order event commits to Kafka.

flows.name: Exchange Execution Fill Capture Flow
flows.description: Streams exchange FIX ExecutionReport fills back onto the Kafka event backbone.

transitions.description: FIX gateway reads risk-approved order command.
Gateway routes FIX 4.4 order to external exchange.
Gateway publishes normalized fill event to Kafka.
